issue.title: test_on_alias_edited_offers_commit_when_in_repo exceeds the flake-baseline gate
issue.description:
tests/test_models_panel_edit_outcomes.py::test_on_alias_edited_offers_commit_when_in_repo
is holding just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake red as a new reproducible flake
(records after 2026-08-15T17:22:27Z, at most 5 failures per run).

REPRODUCTION: just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake names this node alongside
sase-ob (fakey usage-limit ULP compare) and sase-mv (config-cache
test_selector_change_eventually_invalidates_merged_config). Host-local full-run
records that include this nodeid:

- 20260815T233355Z-7d7581a21cc7-137828-full-run.json (sase_11, cost, HEAD 7d7581a21,
  sole failure)
- 20260816T140637Z-78a9130f7536-939696-full-run.json (sase_15, cost, HEAD 78a9130f7,
  72-failure noisy run)
- 20260817T100828Z-cf7eeee03f6c-3358571-full-run.json (sase_18, fast, HEAD cf7eeee03,
  sole failure)

Two of the three records failed only this node, so it is not just a cascade victim.
A later just test-cost run on 2026-08-17 (monitor 9mp1g9hehqgv, 8 workers, 31946
passed / 10 skipped) passed the node, so it is intermittent under the full parallel
lane rather than a deterministic break.

The test pushes ModelsPanel, calls panel._on_alias_edited with a stub
AliasCommitOffer, then wait_for(ConfirmActionModal) and asserts the Commit & Push
copy. The store records only the nodeid, not the assertion; the likely shape is a
wait_for timeout or a missing modal under full-suite ACE/Textual load.

WHY IT MATTERS: after epic sase-ns.6.6 retired already-fixed baseline nodes, this
is a third live node (with sase-ob and sase-mv) keeping check-full's flake-baseline
gate red for every landing agent.

SCOPE: capture a failure traceback from a full-lane miss, then either isolate the
Models-panel commit-offer path from shared ACE/Textual state or harden the wait so
the modal assertion is not load-sensitive. Do not add the node to
tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt without a filed fix-or-retire decision.

Not a duplicate of sase-n5 (different models-panel node:
test_panel_mixed_bucket_sections_title_and_restore). sase-ct is a retired umbrella
and must not be +1'd. sase-j7 is the process-global leak epic; this node is ACE
modal timing until a traceback says otherwise.

Discovered while verifying monitor_node_under_starter; that tree does not touch
Models-panel edit outcomes.
